observations.finding: Both mature side views show the lower feature emerging from the rear of the unchanged roof and rising farther rearward, followed by a short upright upper section turning slightly forward. It does not point toward the face as a long horizontal bar. Fresh, half-age and 25/50/75% training snapshots remain connected.

Both mature side views show a forward/up lower shoulder and a short back/up upper curl. The alternating two-block direction is clear. Intermediate snapshots progressively develop the bend without a separate floating upper piece.

The lower roof addition spans most of the head, then narrows into a middle tier and smaller upper point. Front, rear, side and above images show a broad three-step taper. This is an intentionally blocky cone interpretation with flat cuboid tops, not the smooth source geometry.

The original rectangular head and pixel face stay coherent in all reviewed snapshots. Read-only model comparison additionally confirms the 59 original pivots/rotations, 37 skull/expression/emotion records and 7×6×6 skull bounds unchanged.

Case64 mature Power+Swim has closed horizontal eyelid lines in its front/below snapshots. Its raw full-resolution front was reopened: this is a coherent ordinary closed-eye expression, not missing eyes or a malformed face.

No exposed hidden apex, disconnected tip, crack, elongated limb, visible internal geometry or striped cap join was observed across the 114 current static originals, including intermediate front/back/below views. Hands and feet remain compact in these snapshots.
The yellow orb remains visibly separate in side/front/back views. In above views it can overlap or occlude the crown in projection; these pictures do not imply a 3D intersection.

Recorded live-viewer mature side originals were personally inspected. They show a smooth rising/curling Swim feature, cone-like Power+Swim silhouette and curled Power crest. Final Minecraft directions/lengths follow the user red-line edit, with clean cuboid steps replacing those curves.

limitations: Static selected stage/axis snapshots do not prove every continuous animation frame or the absence of popping at every possible input; dense geometry/motion checks and root movie review are separate evidence.
These natural-coat ordinary Neutral cases do not establish all shiny/color/animal/hat/accessory variants, toy contacts or player attachments.
The fixture actors are server-frozen and raised to permit underside views; no natural hovering or ground-contact behavior is inferred from their apparent height.
No physical phone/touch input, shader/resource-pack/full-modpack behavior, independent multiplayer/latency, audio or full interactive video playback was tested by this reviewer.
The smooth viewer forms are intentionally approximated with a few angled cuboids around a fixed base head, and camera-matched stills may contain different ordinary idle poses or blinks.
